summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston keep reading Ben Shapiro's 2016 novel True Allegiance, mocking its prose and its plot that casts a militarized Texas border, a Detroit riot and suspicion of Muslims as heroic.

evidence.note: Texas governor stations Guard troops on the border; novel presents militarization as making it safe
novel turns to the Juarez cartel; governor later plans a push across the border into Mexico
severed, mutilated head of a Guardsman found in a box, read aloud
militia plots to free a cop who killed a Black child from a Detroit detention center
hosts critique the book's account of Detroit's decline and racial segregation
hosts note the novel treats Muslim anti-Islamophobia activists as terrorist fronts

notes: Middle instalment of the multi-episode True Allegiance reading. Time is the novel's 2016 publication and its unspecified near-present setting (approximate). No theme fits right-wing polemical fiction exactly; propaganda-media chosen as closest, matching sibling records. Mexico setting is fictional (cartel and planned invasion).
